repairs.title: After the attack · a home worth rebuilding
repairs.context: Malachar has fled the ruined guild hall. Rain falls through the broken roof, but the company stays to repair its home and care for one another.
lines: So... who is cleaning this up?
What? I only just got here!
I am carrying this board. It is emotionally heavy.
You are carrying one board. Here—bring it to the damaged wall.
The wall is crooked on purpose. Artistic design.
Check everyone's wounds first. We rebuild together.
Grace! Evangelist, enthusiastic volunteer, occasional ladder problem. Waiz, grab that end—wait, is anyone hurt? We should check first.

seeds.title: Seeds in the Rain
seeds.context: Outside the damaged hall, Sarko finds Levi watching the mountains where Malachar disappeared. Below them, the people of First Light carry supplies and tend the wounded.
lines: You think he will come back soon? You do not seem angry about the destruction.
Yes, he will return. But look at the town. Chadash Adamah means New Earth—not because it is free from suffering, but because God is rebuilding everything.
A seed remains alone unless it enters the ground. Before something greater can grow, the seed must first break. Breaking hurts, but it is not the end.
What happened to Malachar? He carries a mark like ours.
He once protected others. He saw loss and unanswered prayers, and decided that pain meant God could not be good. Pain did not destroy him. Hopelessness did.
Then healing has to mean more than closing a wound.
You are a Shepherd. You remind others why they should keep going.

departure.title: The road to the Heavenly City
departure.context: The company gathers by the guild hearth. Their injuries are real, but so is the bond forming between them. At sunrise they will leave First Light.
lines: We leave at sunrise. The Heavenly City awaits. The road will test your fear, your trust, and your hope. Nobody walks it alone.
I trained others before you. I lost people I wanted to protect. That is why I push you so hard.
You have been carrying that all this time?
Heroes become family before they become legends. We can carry one another's burdens.
Then we should start by agreeing that the carved-stone game was unfair.
Right! Adventure, good news, possibly snacks. But if someone falls behind, we all stop. Nobody walks alone.

gardenInvite.title: An invitation beside the stream
gardenInvite.context: After helping a damaged farming settlement, the weary company rests beside a crystal stream. Naomi has just guided them away from a collapsing path. The water begins to shine.
lines: The path to the left was not safe. Sometimes God shows a moment before it happens.
Prophet deer picks directions from now on.
Bearer of restoration, you carry the light of renewal. There is little time. Those who walk in unity may receive what lies within—but only those who remain as one.
I thought it was legend. Lower your shield, Sarko. This is an invitation.

gardenGift.title: The silver tree
gardenGift.context: A hidden path leads to a luminous silver tree. The gift within the garden belongs to the whole company. Their light draws attention from the shadows.
lines: We spent the morning repairing fences and helping tired families. For once, protecting people meant ordinary kindness.
That matters too. The light is not only for a battlefield.
Receive this gift together. Do not mistake growth for permission to stand alone.
I would prefer our next surprise to stay peaceful.
You have grown quickly. Faster than I expected. This time, I did not come alone.

fractures.title: Malachar returns with allies
fractures.context: Malachar's followers emerge beneath the silver roots. This adaptation uses existing arena creatures for his coordinated assault. The full guild joins the encounter; Levi is already with them this time.
lines: You still believe suffering has purpose? My companions chose truth after Heaven abandoned them.
No. They forgot. Company, hold your formation.
Sarko—shield high, now! They are trying to split our attention.
Kingdom Sanctuary! Stay inside the light. We share the burden.
Waiz hides fear behind laughter. Amaya carries guilt. Hailey fears failure. Your Apostle blames himself for every soul he cannot save.
He is not striking our armor. He is striking the things we hide from one another.
I had an inspiring speech ready. My knees have apparently voted against it. Stay close, will you?

surrender.title: Strength through surrender
surrender.context: The formation falters. Instead of pretending to be invulnerable, the companions admit their fears. Sarko's Shared Burden brightens as they choose trust over pride.
lines: I joke because I hate feeling weak. I lost focus. I need your help.
I judged you for mistakes I make myself. I carried pressure like pride instead of trust.
I am afraid of failing you. So I force things and pretend I am in control.
I thought strength meant carrying everything alone. Shield brother shares the burden. So should I.
God does not unite perfect souls. He unites surrendered ones.
I do not have to control every outcome to stand beside you. Together—again!
All right. One breath, one step, one wildly hopeful horse. Come on—we can do this together.

rexArrival.title: The Dragon King
rexArrival.context: Malachar is driven back against the silver tree, but he smiles toward the sky. Rex Draconum descends, spreading his vast wings above the garden. The Dragon King himself has come.
lines: Rex Draconum. Why reveal yourself now?
Because hope grows dangerous when ignored. Allow me to correct your expectations.
My sanctuary... he shattered it without trying.
You believe dependence protects people. Strength would have prevented your wounds.
No. Love stayed when strength failed.
Then show me how long your faith endures when those you protect begin to fall.

rexAfter.title: A threat, not a victory
rexAfter.context: The company survives Rex's overwhelming demonstration. He chooses to leave with Malachar; the heroes have not defeated him. Sarko reaches for restoration rather than revenge.
lines: My king, we can finish them.
No. They are not ready. The Heavenly City will reveal whether their faith was ever real.
Divine Restoration. Come back to the light, everyone.
The Spirit of God sustains us.
And through the Son, we stand. This was not the end of our road.
This is not just power. It is purpose.
Well, that was considerably more dragon than I ordered. Hey—look at me. You are safe with us. Nobody left.

breath.title: Breath of Heaven
breath.context: Corrupted creatures converge on the damaged garden. Hailey sees too many threats at once. With the others beside her, she finds the courage to raise her bow.
lines: There are too many angles. I am afraid I will miss when you need me most.
Stand firm in faith. You do not have to carry this alone.
But you did. We move forward together.

kingLies.title: The King of Lies
kingLies.context: In a canyon of glowing blue stone, Rex approaches without his crushing aura. His offer sounds gentle: limitless power, if Sarko will abandon dependence and trust only himself.
lines: You heal, protect, sacrifice—and still you kneel. Why choose between light and darkness when both can belong to you?
If my healing had no limits... could I keep everyone safe?
Sarko, do not listen. He is using your fear of failure.
What if you no longer served Heaven, but surpassed it?
Creation does not surpass its Creator. God never feared humanity becoming powerful. He feared what pride would turn us into.
I remember what carried us here. Love—not control.
That is not a gift, Sarko. That is a chain with a very shiny ribbon. We already have you; you do not need to earn us.

finalStand.title: The fall of the Dragon King
finalStand.context: Rex returns above the shattered canyon, his wings casting a shadow over the company. Isaac and Sarko form the front line, Levi guides their defense, and the others cover the flanks and fire from the rear.
lines: Stand together, so you may fall together.
Everyone together! Protect the line. Watch for the opening.
I can see the wing joints. Cover me while I aim.
His power is consuming him. Do not let his anger break our formation.
Archers, I have your opening! Waiz, try to keep up. And please do not trip over my longsword.

restoration.title: Love restores
restoration.context: Dragonfire breaks through the barrier and Hailey falls badly injured. The scene avoids graphic injury. Sarko reaches her while the others hold the line, and radiant restoration returns her strength.
lines: That was unpleasant. My bow—there. I can still fight.
I supported her. The regeneration is part of how the Creator made her. Love restores what power destroys.
Now! Every opening, cover one another. Together!

rexDefeat.title: The king lays down control
rexDefeat.context: Rex falters as the guild’s coordinated attack breaks his defenses. Sarko offers restoration rather than hatred, and corruption loosens its grip on the exhausted Dragon King.
lines: So... this is what unity looks like.
No. This is what love looks like.
All this time, I thought strength meant never needing anyone.
And where did that road lead you?
Courage is not never being afraid. I can protect and love people without controlling everything that happens to them.
Does this count as a team-building exercise?
Mercy! Unexpected, brilliant, and much better than another argument. Let us help him up—carefully.

cityGates.title: The Heavenly City
cityGates.context: Beyond the canyon lies the final valley. Crystal rivers flow beneath radiant walls. The company approaches open gates, and the weight of exhaustion begins to lift.
lines: How do you even describe that?
The King has awaited your arrival.
No pain. No exhaustion. I can hardly believe it.
Oh! Oh, look at the gates! I had so many words ready... Sarko, we actually made it. All of us.

cityWelcome.title: The heart of a Shepherd
cityWelcome.context: Inside the City, gentle light draws the company forward. Jesus welcomes Sarko with kindness that reaches back to the storm and the failure he has carried for so long.
lines: I saw you in the rain.
I thought I had to make up for it.
You were never asked to become everyone's savior. You were called to follow Me faithfully.
I can protect them. I can love them. But I am not their Savior.
Now you understand the heart of a Shepherd. You are home now.
I thought belonging was something I had to earn. Thank You for bringing us home.

cityPurpose.title: A journey complete · a purpose beginning
cityPurpose.context: The city is not the end of love's work. Beyond its gates, countless travelers still journey toward the light. The company receives a purpose that fits what they have learned together.
lines: Our journey to the City is over. But our purpose is only beginning.
Then I suppose there are more people who need encouraging.
And none of them should have to walk alone.
Then what are we waiting for? Well—one hug first. Then we carry that welcome to everyone still searching.
